findings.finding: When multiple nodes are live but no selected node exists, the entire logging ng-view is hidden while allLogNodes defaults false. The All nodes checkbox inside that view cannot be reached until a user chooses a node; a fresh or invalid-restored selection triggers this case.

Node-system request completions have no generation check, and systemError is cleared only on request start. Filtering or paging can overlap refreshes, so an older failure arriving after a newer successful request marks a healthy node unavailable; older success can overwrite newer values.
